Subject: AtlasOps discovery recap — VPC pilot scope, timeline & procurement pulse

Diego — thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have alignment on scope and timing: 

Summary of conversation
- Goal: pilot Redwood Dedicated (VPC) for inference workloads behind AtlasOps private network; proof point = 50 RPS gen at p95 latency <= 200ms for 2k token sequences.
- Primary constraints: SOC2 evidence, KMS integration (customer-managed), and audit logs retained 13 months.
- Ops asks: VPC peering + egress policy review, and an SRE runbook for failover to hosted fallback.

Proposed pilot scope (what we can deliver in the pilot)
- 2-week sandbox in your VPC region (us-west-2) with 1 dedicated GPU node, prefetched model image, and prefix cache enabled.
- Simple load profile and runbook for traffic shaping and KV cache warm-up.
- Deliverables: SOW draft, architecture diagram, and preflight checklist for your infra.

Next steps / asks
1) Please confirm priority (pilot in Q2 vs later) — we tentatively earmarked a pilot window in the week of 5/3 if you want that.
2) Share procurement path (PO vs contract), and any procurement contacts to loop in for SOW turnaround.
3) Technical: can your infra team confirm whether AtlasOps will provide a KMS endpoint (yes/no) and required CIDR allowlist?

Attached: redwood-vpc-arch.png (arch draft), SOW-draft-AtlasOps.docx (skeleton).

Happy to jump on a brief follow-up if helpful — I can have Laura (solutions) do a 30-min checklist review with your SREs.

Thanks,
— Priyom
